title: ZeroGallery
summary: Browse folders and view photos and videos with the arrow keys
description: Pick a folder and flip through its photos and videos full screen with the arrow keys (F/X/Z/C work with or without Fn). JPEG photos open natively with EXIF rotation; every other image format, animated GIFs and all videos are decoded by the system ffmpeg, with sound through PipeWire. In a video the arrows skip 10 or 30 seconds back and forth. Turn the device and the photo or video turns with it. Press V to send what you are viewing to a smart TV over DLNA (LG, Samsung, Sony, Hisense…) or to a Chromecast, Google TV or Nest Hub over Google Cast (the TV plays the original file at full quality), or to a screen plugged into the HDMI port (with its sound; press A to choose speaker, headphones, HDMI or a USB or Bluetooth audio device by name), and the arrows, pause and next / previous keep working on the TV. ESC goes back, hold ESC to exit.
